| Library | Version | License | Source | Verified |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| htmx | 2.0.11 | 0BSD | npm registry tarball htmx.org-2.0.11.tgz, dist/htmx.min.js | npm sha512 integrity matched |
| TradingView Lightweight Charts | 5.2.1 | Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE, NOTICE) | npm registry tarball lightweight-charts-5.2.1.tgz, dist/lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js | npm sha512 integrity matched |

Lightweight Charts requires attribution: the Cockpit chart shows the TradingView logo link (attributionLogo option, on by default).
